Thomas rejected both offers, chose to bet on himself, and didn't make a counteroffer. The gamble never paid off. He was later waived by both the Nets and the Bucks, and has been without a team since March. It's a stunning turn of events for a player who, not long ago, was viewed as a potential franchise cornerstone. The NBA moves fast. One decision can completely change the trajectory of a career 🤷‍♂️
